description:
**Email Enquiries Only**

Doran Estates are delighted to present 33 Kellys Bay Strand, four-bedroom semi-detached home to the rental market, ideally located in a quiet and established residential development in Skerries. Offering generous accommodation, modern interiors and a superb coastal setting, this property is just approximately 50 metres from the seafront.

The ground floor begins with a bright entrance hallway leading into a spacious living room, complete with feature fireplace. To the rear, the modern kitchen and dining area provides a well-planned space for everyday living and opens directly onto the private rear garden. A separate sitting room also benefits from garden access, offering valuable additional living space. A guest WC completes the ground floor.
Upstairs, there are three generous double bedrooms and a well-proportioned single bedroom. The principal bedroom features a private en-suite bathroom, while a contemporary family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms.
Externally, the property benefits from a generous private rear garden with a convenient side entrance, providing excellent outdoor space and additional practicality.
The location is a particular highlight. With the seafront just moments away, residents can enjoy coastal walks, beaches and the relaxed atmosphere of one of North Dublin's most popular seaside towns. Skerries village is within easy walking distance and offers a wide range of cafés, restaurants, shops, supermarkets and local services, with Skerries Point Shopping Centre also close by.
Transport links are excellent, with Skerries Train Station providing regular rail services to Dublin City Centre and surrounding areas, while Dublin Bus routes offer additional options for getting around. The M1 motorway is also easily accessible, making travel towards Dublin and beyond straightforward.

Combining spacious accommodation, modern presentation and an exceptional coastal location, this property offers a fantastic opportunity to enjoy the best of life in Skerries.
